scope: Proposition 5.2 of the manuscript “Modularity of elliptic curves over imaginary quadratic fields” (preprints/Modularity-of-elliptic-curves-over-imaginary-quadratic-fields-October-4-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 030 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c74cc37755f500be), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 13. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: If θ has order m > 1 dividing n, the system Vθ is realized by the corresponding character space in H1(Cm). For the trivial character, V1,ℓ ≃ H1 ét(Bt,F , Qℓ). Let Dt = C3(t)/⟨w⟩ and At = Jac(Dt). Then Dt has genus one, At is an elliptic curve over F, and for either nontrivial order-three character η there are GF -equivariant isomorphisms Vη,ℓ ≃ H1 ét(At,F , Qℓ) for every ℓ.
